description: This Java source file defines a sample Android service named SampleVisualQueryDetectionService that extends VisualQueryDetectionService. It captures camera frames and audio input to detect visual queries and stream partial query results. The service manages camera and microphone resources, processes camera images upon receipt, and simulates attention detection. The code indicates this is part of a feature for voice interaction detection on Android devices.

classes.name: SampleVisualQueryDetectionService
classes.description: A sample Android detection service that captures camera images and audio to perform visual query detection, managing camera and microphone resources, and simulating attention detection within an Android environment.

methods.name: onStartDetection
methods.description: Initializes background threads, opens camera, and prepares audio recording when detection starts.

methods.name: onStopDetection
methods.description: Releases all resources and stops background threads when detection stops.

methods.name: onUpdateState
methods.description: Handles updates to the detection state; in this case, simply reports status as 0.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources upon service destruction.

methods.name: onReceiveImage
methods.description: Processes incoming camera image frames, encodes them, simulates attention, and triggers speech detection.

methods.name: onReceiveAudio
methods.description: Reads audio data from microphone input and streams a fake query for demonstration.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Initializes camera by selecting camera ID, creating image reader, and opening the camera device.

methods.name: initializeImageReader
methods.description: Configures ImageReader to handle camera frames.

methods.name: createCameraPreview
methods.description: Sets up the camera capture request and session for preview frames.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Starts or updates the camera preview stream.

methods.name: openMicrophone
methods.description: Starts audio recording and begins reading input.

methods.name: releaseResources
methods.description: Cleans up and releases camera and audio resources.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts background handler threads for camera and audio processing.
